mapper.update: UPDATE doctors SET department_id = #{departmentId}, full_name = #{fullName}, qualification = #{qualification}, specialization = #{specialization}, registration_number = #{registrationNumber}, experience_years = #{experienceYears}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, about = #{about}, consultation_fee = #{consultationFee}, daily_limit = #{dailyLimit}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
